messages:
maria: FYI reproduced bad oscillation in dedicated pools: short spike -> scale up -> autoscaler tears nodes down -> next spike hits p99s.
chetan: can you share quick repro steps / load shape?
maria: simple: spike 30s @ 80 concurrent, pause 40s, spike 30s. second spike falls after downscale completes.
elena: sounds like our downscale logic ignores recent spike history. options: longer cooldown, TTL on new nodes, or richer signals.
max: any fix must be bounded so protection doesn't starve other tenants.
chetan: thinking: adaptive protection TTL per scale-up based on observed inter-spike intervals + tenant priority. shorter for bursty but cheap tenants, longer for high-slo tenants.
maria: also: introduce an ephemeral credit bucket so tenants can absorb small follow-up spikes without forcing new nodes. credits refill slowly and are consumed on protected capacity use.
elena: +prefer evicting cold nodes (cache-score) and add a soft-drain state where nodes accept a small number of requests before full termination.
max: operationally we need dashboards: protected-node count, credit consumption, post-evict resurge rate. also a simulator to test TTL & credit tradeoffs.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled down pool "dedicated-gpu-pool-3" by 1 node (reason: idle-window=75s). alert rule "resurge-after-evict" created.
chetan: rollout plan: feature-flag, pilot two tenants for 2 weeks, metric gates on resurge rate and monthly cost delta.
maria: action items: draft RFC for adaptive-ttl + crediting (maria), implement soft-drain + cache-score exporter (elena), simulation harness + cost matrix (max).
elena: will prototype cache-score exporter next sprint.
max: I'll stand up a small sim starting Monday and run TTLs {30s,60s,120s}.
chetan: also add hard global guard: if pool spare capacity < threshold, ignore protections for low-priority tenants to prevent starvation.
maria: sounds good. I'll post RFC link when ready and assign reviewers. thanks all.
